## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Models and reference cases agree on Benign [F1] in this unflagged simulated frozen section with clear suggested margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0%, Normal 0% | Strong benign score; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign (alpha 10%, 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Quality flag off; atypical OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (81%–89% similarity) [F5] | All five neighbors match Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.66, contribution -1.08) lowers invasive risk [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 7) · context · Below-typical descriptive score (-0.22, contribution +0.68) [F3]; AI check 8/20 · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.71, contribution -0.67) lowers risk [F4]; caption inconsistent · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-average z-score (-0.76, contribution +0.57); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion difference +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal DCIS or invasion in high-risk regions 1 (81%) or 6 (77%) is diluted across the image.
- Severity-3 resample degradation on this simulated frozen section obscures atypia while HoVer-Net cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (81%, 77% risk) to exclude focal invasion or in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 2, 8**: Check superior, inferior, and medial margins where segment scores reach 99% despite clear call.
3. **Regions 5, 7, 8, 9**: Verify benign tubules (caption-inconsistent score) and duct-confined epithelium in region 7.
